itch_io.access: itch.io downloads CAN be driven without a browser. Flow: GET project page -> csrf_token from meta tag -> parse init_ViewGame JSON for the CANONICAL slug (often differs from the URL) -> POST csrf to /download_url -> GET signed page -> POST csrf to /file/<upload_id>?source=game_download -> signed R2 URL. Free and name-your-own-price only.
